title: The Fee Base for a Granite Ridge Carry-Forward Election
content:
The fee base from which a Granite Ridge Season Pass Programme carry-forward fee is worked out is taken as follows.

**First.** Where the pass record was opened as a renewal of a pass held in the preceding season and the price committed to on the pass record stands below the tier's standard season price, the fee base is one tenth of the price committed to on the pass record, a share of 10 per cent of that price.

**Second.** Where the pass record was not opened as such a renewal, the pass account shows an amount placed on it to be collected by instalments, and the price committed to stands below the tier's standard season price, the fee base is the carry-forward fee the tier carries reduced in the proportion the price committed to bears to the tier's standard season price.

**Otherwise.** In any other case the fee base is not moved by this rule.

### The three ways the base is taken

| How the pass record was opened | The price committed to against the tier's standard season price | An amount placed on the account to be collected by instalments | The fee base |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| a renewal of a pass held in the preceding season | below it | either | one tenth of the price committed to |
| not such a renewal | below it | yes | the tier's carry-forward fee in the proportion the price committed to bears to the standard season price |
| not such a renewal | below it | no | not moved by this rule |
| either | at or above it | either | not moved by this rule |

The proportion in the second case is the price committed to set against the tier's standard season price, and the tier's carry-forward fee is taken in that proportion.

### Worked on hypothetical figures

A Granite Ridge Summit Pass, whose standard season price is 1149.00 and whose carry-forward fee is 129.00, on a record committed to 1029.00.

Where the record was opened as a renewal and committed to 1029.00, the fee base is one tenth of 1029.00, which is 102.90. Where a record on the same tier was not opened as such a renewal, the pass account shows an amount placed on it to be collected by instalments and the price committed to is 1034.10, which is nine tenths of that standard season price, the fee base is 129.00 taken in that proportion, which is 116.10.
